source.title: Gap Junctional Blockade Stochastically Induces Different Species-Specific Head Anatomies in Genetically Wild-Type Girardia dorotocephala Flatworms.
source.location: Results section 2.1 text (refers to Figure S1A)

stage: pre-tail (PT) fragment (posterior to pharynx, anterior to tail)
injury: amputation posterior to the pharynx but anterior to the tail (decapitated pre-tail fragment)

intervention.description: Pre-tail fragments left to regenerate in plain water for 10 days with no drug.

readout.method: visual scoring of regenerated head shape

notes: Text states head regeneration in water has "100% fidelity" to the species-specific shape and that variant shapes were never observed; n for the water arm is not stated, so percentage entered as counts. Figure S1A (supplement) not on disk.
